scripts.pb: npm run prebuild && npm run copy:android
scripts.copy:android: WIN=${WIN_DIR:-/mnt/c/lib} && rm -rf $WIN/android/app/build/generated && rsync -a --delete --exclude='app/build' --exclude='app/.cxx' --exclude='.gradle' --exclude='.idea' --exclude='local.properties' ./android/ $WIN/android/ && cp package.json package-lock.json $WIN/ && touch $WIN/index.ts && sed -i 's|// debuggableVariants = .*|debuggableVariants = ["debug", "release"]|' $WIN/android/app/build.gradle
scripts.bundle: WIN=${WIN_DIR:-/mnt/c/lib} && mkdir -p $WIN/android/app/src/main/assets && NODE_ENV=production npx expo export:embed --platform android --dev false --reset-cache --entry-file index.ts --bundle-output $WIN/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest $WIN/android/app/src/main/res && node_modules/react-native/sdks/hermesc/linux64-bin/hermesc -O -emit-binary -output-source-map -out $WIN/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle $WIN/android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle
